_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Du bis Speler {player_id} in 'n {num_players}-spelers Liar's Dice spel.
Regele:
- Op dien beurt, maog du ÈÈn van twieë dinge doon:
  1) 'n Nujen bieje mit 'n hoeëger kwantiteit of 'n hoeëger gesich (of allebei) as de hujige bieje; dus '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) De lèste bieje roppe door '[Call]' te typen.

Es du rop:
  - Es de echte tel van dae gesichwaarde ónder de dobbelsteine minder is as de bieje, dan verluus de lèste biejer eine dobbelsteen.
  - Anders verluus de ropers eine dobbelsteen.
'ne Speler dae biej 0 dobbelsteine kump, is oetgesjlaote. De lèste rèsjerende speler wint.

board.new_round:
Nujen rónj - Resterende dobbelsteine: {dice_summary}
Din hujige dobbelsteine zint: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Speler {current_player_id} rop! De echte tel van gesich {face_value} is {count}, wat >= {quantity}.
Speler {loser_id} (de ropers) verluus eine dobbelsteen.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Oproep gemaak zonder e veurbiege bod.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Actie woort neet herkènd es 'n gèldige '[Bid: X, Y]' of '[Call]'. Ingevoerde actie: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Nieuwe hoeveelheid {new_quantity} is lager dan de huidige {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nieje nominale waerde {new_face_value} is lager es de huidige {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Bied is identiek aan 't huidig bied.
bid_reason.face_range: Nominale waarde mós tösse 1 en 6 ligke.

message.eliminated_invalid: Speler {player_id} is geëlimineerd door ongeldige zet.
